hero.name: ALEX
hero.title: VIDEO EDITOR
hero.intro: I transform raw footage into compelling visual stories through creative editing, smooth transitions, and thoughtful storytelling. Helping creators and brands turn their ideas into engaging content.

about.heading: Editor. Creator. Storyteller.
about.text:
Hi, I'm Alex, a passionate video editor who believes every video has a story worth telling.
I specialize in transforming raw footage into engaging visual experiences through creative editing, smooth transitions, motion graphics, and thoughtful storytelling.
My approach combines creativity with attention to detail, ensuring every project communicates its message effectively and leaves a lasting impression.
Whether it's content for social media, YouTube, or brands, my goal is to bring ideas to life through impactful visuals.

contact.heading: Have a Project in Mind?
contact.text: Have an idea you'd love to bring to life? Whether it's a YouTube video, social media content, or a creative brand project, I'd love to hear about it. Let's work together to create something meaningful.
